name: Intertitle
purpose: Find a film for tonight, explore your taste, and keep the conversation going.
description: A film companion grounded in personal taste — separate from the public App Store release.
sourceLabel: Native iOS build, isolated Simulator, fixture data
demoScope: Seven current stills from a source-owned presentation fixture, captured in an isolated development build. Every film, person, rating, match percentile and taste explanation is fixture data — this demonstrates presentation, not a live recommender or real taste inference. A development preview, not the public App Store release.
engineeringNotes: Recommendation constraints and retry-safe conversation state make the choice easier to revise.
working: A film-detail view that pairs a fixture match percentile with a stated reason
A film-anchored Reely thread that carries prior context into a refinement
Diary, People and Friends surfaces populated with fixture data
remaining: No live recommendation model — every match percentile and "why this one" explanation comes from the fixture, not real taste inference
Reely makes no live model call in this build; external services are hard-disabled under the fixture
The people and friends shown are fixture profiles, not a real community
A development preview, not the public App Store release

name: PAZZ Marketplace
purpose: Follow a vehicle from discovery into a lease application.
description: A Mexican vehicle-leasing marketplace that brings discovery, qualification, and partner handoffs into one path.
sourceLabel: Isolated local dev build, browser captures
demoScope: Seven current captures from an isolated local dev ring: the quoting flow from vehicle spec to a real-cost estimate and term comparison, Claudio's guided search, and a flag-gated partner-application intake. All amounts, applicant and contact details are synthetic, and every estimate is illustrative, not a lessor offer.
engineeringNotes: Shared domain rules and recoverable document handoffs keep operating decisions consistent.
working: A quoting flow that turns a vehicle spec into a real-cost estimate — rent, estimated ISR deduction, creditable IVA — compared across terms
Claudio, a guided-search adviser that carries a confirmed budget into vehicle questions
A partner-application intake, gated behind a feature flag rather than live
remaining: Every amount is a local illustrative estimate, not a lessor offer — the product itself labels it "Estimación, no oferta"
Claudio runs on a deterministic scripted mock (USE_REAL_AGENT_MODEL off); no live model call and no autonomous decision
The partner application sits behind USE_PARTNER_PORTAL_V2, off by default while the partner program stays intentionally dark
The vehicle catalog itself isn't shown here: its cards currently render an "Imagen en validación" placeholder because licensed vehicle media doesn't exist yet

name: Maestro
purpose: A closer look at what's happening inside a music session.
description: A music-production workspace that turns session signals into inspectable evidence before you act on them.
demoScope: Synthetic session data traveling through the real local WebSocket server, session aggregation, and the real React/Tauri interface. No real audio, DAW, or coaching API is used.
engineeringNotes: Missing or stale audio evidence stays visible in the UI instead of being papered over with a confident guess.
working: Synthetic session registration and track ingest through the real local server
Masking analysis surfaced per track, with the finding kept visible in the UI
Mixer and spectrum views rendered by the real local application
remaining: No AU/VST or FFT extraction from real PCM audio
No Logic Pro or other DAW bridge — the bridge process is a safety stub
No coaching API; the assistant panel is not wired to a model

name: Temper
purpose: Connect the day's recovery, food and training to a plan you can actually follow.
description: A training week that fits real constraints before it becomes an active plan.
demoScope: Eight current stills — Today, Food, the active meal plan, this week's training, the progress trend, a Coach proposal, the active plan review, and its full revision history — plus a 58-second recorded tour. Every readiness, food, training and weight number is synthetic fixture data; no HealthKit or WHOOP sync.
engineeringNotes: Local drafts and commit-time validation keep an impossible schedule visible instead of silently starting it. Every plan revision carries who changed it and why, and a pending Coach proposal is shown as a proposal to accept or decline, never an already-applied change.
working: A day view that ties readiness, check-ins, meals and training into one read
A meal plan accepted for the week, tracked meal by meal against its targets
A Coach proposal — three concrete setting deltas with reasoning — shown for review, not auto-applied
A full revision ledger: every plan setting shows who changed it and why (Coach vs. you), not just its current value
remaining: No HealthKit or WHOOP sync — readiness, sleep, weight, food and training numbers are synthetic fixture data
Captured in an isolated iOS Simulator build; physical-device acceptance is incomplete
Coach is a scripted plan/proposal surface, not an autonomous or AI-powered agent
